goal: Return lease-less outstanding assignments on --exclude-reviewer so a stranded slot (lease already released, no verdict) can be redrawn; approved assignments with verdicts are never stripped
prohibited_actions: do not touch any migration or database object
do not strip an assignment that already recorded a durable verdict
do not edit another session's handoff, worktree, branch, or claim
assumptions: parseTerminalFailureEvidence on main already accepts replacement-format failure refs (#3730); this PR fixes the remaining exclude-returns-empty gap
the implementation commit precedes the published contract ref
stop_conditions: stop if a test fails for a reason unrelated to the exclusion return path
stop if the change would need to touch a file outside allowed_paths
